infobox.usage: Unlocks a room with an additional extraction in the ZB-014 bunker on Woods.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: ZB-014 key (ZB-014) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A rather unusual door key with some engravings reading "ZB-014".

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 1 needs to be found for the quest Aid Stations

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: On the desk in dorm room 220 on the second floor of the three-story dorms.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Inside the ZB-014 bunker in the west of Woods.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Weapon box (6x6)
- ZB-014 extraction (Green flare = Open)
